title: Help
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.offline.q: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.offline.a: Only to download the app the first time (about 32 MB). Practice, analysis and results work without a connection after that.
faq.placement.a: On a tripod, outside the swing path. The first setup step draws the distance and height for your venue. Measure the mat the first time you use a venue.
faq.modes.q: What is the difference between live mode and slow-motion import?
faq.modes.a: Live mode analyses tempo and body movement straight from the camera. For ball speed, launch and carry, record in iPhone slow motion and import the video from Files.
faq.null.a: When a number cannot be measured from this angle or this video, it shows — with the reason instead of a guess. Another camera angle can usually measure it.
faq.ci.a: It is a 95% confidence interval: the true value is inside that range about 95% of the time. The narrower the range, the more reliable the number.
faq.carry.a: Carry is always an estimate: spin is not measured and wind is ignored. It is most useful for comparing your own swings with each other.
faq.phases.q: How are the swing phases found?
faq.phases.a: By rules that follow your wrists and body to find address, the top of the swing, impact and the rest. If one is wrong you can correct it on the result screen.
faq.data.a: Only in this phone's browser. There is no account and nothing is uploaded. Back up in History before you change phones or clear data.
faq.eviction.a: If the app is not opened for a while, iPhone may delete website data. Adding it to your Home Screen and turning on protection under Storage makes this less likely; please also back up regularly.

glossary.hint: What each number on the result screen means, and the range most amateurs see.
report.title: Report a problem
report.body: Open an issue on GitHub; you can attach the report from Diagnostics. The app never sends anything by itself.
